title: Create test artifact to verify loop functionality
objective: Create a simple text file at workspace/test.txt with content 'Loop works!' to verify the factory can create artifacts end-to-end.
hypothesis: If the factory loop is functioning correctly, writing a simple file to the workspace will succeed and the file will exist with correct content.
implementation_steps: Create directory workspace/ if it does not exist
Verify the file exists and contains correct content

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: workspace/test.txt exists and contains exactly 'Loop works!'

notes: Simple sanity check to verify the factory loop can create artifacts
